musicbrainz_contact.title: MusicBrainz Contact
musicbrainz_contact.description: Contact (email or URL) embedded in the mandatory descriptive MusicBrainz User-Agent. Optional — the server ships a default — but operators should set their own so MusicBrainz can reach them about traffic.
